content: Web Push (RFC 8291/8292 VAPID) from Deno Edge Functions works via @negrel/webpush (runtime-agnostic, no node deps); generate VAPID keys once, store private key in secrets, send encrypted push to stored PushSubscription endpoints. Supabase has official push-notification edge function guides. Node web-push lib is not Deno-friendly; use @negrel/webpush. Handle 404/410 responses by deleting dead subscriptions.
